action.prompt: If the feature spec you are implementing is now fully complete (all tasks done and verified), make sure docs/implementation-notes/<spec-name>.md exists and follows the standing format exactly: ## What was built, ## Files created / modified (table), ## Decisions I made (never omit; say "none" if none), ## AX contract added (Playwright aria-snapshot style, per tenant where they differ), ## Audit rows this feature writes (table), ## Tests added (each with the requirement it covers), ## Known gaps. If the spec is not finished yet, or the notes file already exists and is current, do nothing.
